end.line: Quillon for Norrland Telecom’s commercial legal team

vo: Norrland Telecom signs about six hundred tower and spectrum agreements a year, and sales wants redlines within a day.
In Word, Quillon redlines the counterparty draft to your playbook, with every change explained beside it.
Vault reads every agreement at once, so renewal terms buried in PDFs come back in one table.
And your negotiated positions are remembered, so each new redline starts from what legal already agreed.
Elin will walk your team through it on Tuesday the seventeenth.
